policy: Normal fresh-save worlds. Life uses legal in-season farm crops and public farm actions; seasonal crop sale variant sells harvest goods through the public material trade action. Adventure periodically enters public forest encounters and fights by public combatTurn; Mixed alternates both. Only active-policy scenarios perform succession after death: choose the first living adult NPC in state order, matching App.vue successor-list filtering, then call public chooseSuccessor. No-intervention and settlement control fixtures do not take succession as a player action.
timeModel: Real simulation.simulate(), advanced in canonical one-day intervals; no parallel world model.
